# Vocabulary: runtime

Where in the lifecycle the technique runs.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `offline-authoring` | Offline authoring | Used by developers before ship; outputs are baked. |
| `design-assist` | Design assist | Interactive tool in the editor or for designers and modders. |
| `server-realtime` | Server real-time | Runs during play on cloud or game servers. |
| `client-realtime` | Client real-time | Runs during play on the player's device. |
| `analytics` | Analytics / live-ops | Runs on telemetry to tune, test, or personalize. |
